payload.core_composition_summary: Sort array to greedily maximize mex; then use hash map and min-heap to minimize distinct elements in remainder.
payload.rationale: Mex is built by filling gaps in sorted order. Remaining operations reduce distinctness via greedy smallest-frequency elimination, using Counter and heap.
